headline: Recommended Fifield Room technology upgrades, estimated at $147,000 to $200,000, and approved a final principal increase.
summary: Mr. Soto recommended first fixing connectivity and sound quality in the room. Meetings may need to move elsewhere during the work, since the Fifield Room is the only space with local cable broadcasting. Mr. Soto also said he did not expect the projected $862,000 surplus to remain, because the State's final assessments were higher than the Cherry Sheet amounts used in the budget.
decisions: Recommended Fifield Room upgrades to the full School Committee, passed unanimously.
Approved the final principal increase FY26-27 performance document, passed unanimously.
Received the June 2026 Financial Report and the July and August 2027 Financial Report, passed unanimously.
Approved the 5.7.26 Finance and Operations Subcommittee meeting minutes, passed unanimously.
